record_error_uids: create an ErrorRegistry and record a list of item UIDs that errored into the SQLite-backed advisory cache
query_error_uids: get the subset of item UIDs that previously errored from an ErrorRegistry using the get method
clear_error_uids: clear specific error rows from the ErrorRegistry by passing a list of item UIDs to the clear method
test_lazy_db_connect: test that the ErrorRegistry lazily creates the SQLite database on first operation and safely reconnects after external deletion
test_concurrent_writers: test that multiple threads can concurrently write to the same ErrorRegistry using busy-timeout retries without data loss
